sentences.text: Shri Suresh Agrawal, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri B.K.Sharma, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.

This appeal is though filed under Section 76 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, however,
there is non-compliance of provision contained under sub section 1 of section 76 which contemplates the deposit of the amount imposed by way of penalty or compensation or damage.
Let compliance be effected within fifteen days, failing which the appeal shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Court.
In case the compliance is effected, let the matter be set out for hearing on admission in the week commencing 5.2.2018.

(SANJAY YADAV) (ANAND PATHAK)
 JUDGE JUDGE vv Mukesh Verma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Thr on 19 January, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140643858/
